name: Vraille
tagline: Smart glasses plus a dynamic Braille display that describe surroundings and people to visually impaired users.
problem: Smart glasses target convenience features, not comprehensive systems for visually impaired people.
solution: Glasses capture the scene; multimodal AI describes it and recognises faces; a custom dynamic Braille interface and voice agent deliver the information.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the glasses at someone and feel their name in Braille.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VAPI: Best Voice AI Application” among 261 submissions.
Built custom Braille hardware, designed in CAD.

lessons: Custom output hardware shows commitment to the user, not just to the model.
